name: appeal_revision_periods
description: Limitation Act 1963 Schedule — periods (in days) for appeals and revisions consumed by the appeal / revision / condone-delay pipelines. Keyed by a stable remedy key.

source.section: Schedule Arts. 115 (criminal appeals: death 30 days; other sentence to HC 60 days, to any other court 30 days), 116 (civil appeals: to HC 90 days, to any other court 30 days), 131 (revision under CPC / CrPC: 90 days)
